_note: Every entry cites a public source. A = new enablers (2023-2026). B = measured pains (all sectors, EU/Cyprus). C = mechanisms that work in a distant field. Tags drive compatibility; 'field' drives strangeness.

A.name: Agents that can pay per request (x402 / stablecoin micropayments)
Autonomous computer-use agents that operate any web portal
EU Data Act: users can demand the data their connected devices generate (from 12 Sep 2025)
Instant SEPA payments mandatory for all euro banks (2025)
EU Digital Identity Wallet with business attestations (by end-2026)
Mandatory e-invoicing / real-time VAT reporting (ViDA, 2030; national earlier)
Open finance data access (FiDA proposal) beyond payment accounts
Cheap on-device vision models reading paper, meters, shelves in real time
Smart meters with 15-min data rolling out in Cyprus (EAC AMI programme)
Daily free satellite imagery at 3-10m (Sentinel-2, Planet NICFI-style access)
Digital Product Passport requirement (ESPR, batteries first 2027)
LLM voice agents that hold natural phone calls in Greek/English
Tokenised deposits / programmable money pilots (ECB DLT settlement trials)
EU Accessibility Act in force for SME digital services (28 Jun 2025)
Parametric triggers from public weather/sensor feeds priced automatically

B.name: SMEs answer many differently-worded sustainability requests from banks/customers
Energy cost is a major barrier for ~50% of EU firms; SMEs under-invest in efficiency
Late payment: ~50% of EU invoices paid late; SMEs hit hardest
Cyprus water scarcity: desalination dependence, reservoirs below 20% (2025)
Tourism seasonality: Cyprus hotels/staff idle half the year
Red tape: EU SMEs cite administrative burden as top obstacle (Eurobarometer 2023)
Farmers lose crops to heat/drought with slow or no insurance payout
Food waste: ~130 kg per EU citizen/year, retail+hospitality large share
Island grid curtailment: Cyprus wastes solar output at midday (no interconnector)
SMEs can't get credit: thin files, no collateral (SAFE survey)
Used goods and repairs lack trusted history, so resale value collapses
Staff shortages in hospitality/care; workers paid late, shifts unfilled
Grant and subsidy money goes unclaimed; SMEs don't know or can't apply
Heatwaves: buildings overheat, elderly and workers at risk (Cyprus 45C+)
Property and utility disputes between landlords and tenants over shared costs

C.name: Airline yield management: price changes by demand minute to minute
Chess/Elo rating: ranking from pairwise outcomes, no absolute measure needed
Blood-bank / organ matching: time-critical allocation of scarce perishable supply
Reinsurance: pooling many small risks and selling slices to big capital
Air-traffic control: live deconfliction of many actors in shared space
Spotify royalties: tiny usage events settled into automatic payouts
Carfax-style history report built from many third-party events
Ant colony / stigmergy: coordination through traces left in the environment
Clinical triage: route cases by urgency with a short standard question set
Futures market: sell next season's output today to lock a price
Container shipping standard (TEU): one box fits every ship, truck, crane
Speedrun/leaderboard gaming: public live competition drives behaviour
Tontine / rotating savings club (ROSCA): members fund each other in turn
Prediction market: price aggregates dispersed knowledge into a probability
Pharmacovigilance: tiny signals from many reports detect rare problems early
